news.title: CrowdStrike Rebounds 2%, Palo Alto Up 2% as Cloudflare Finds “An Even Higher Gear”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCrowdStrike rose 2% today after Cloudflare reported 39% revenue growth and raised its full-year outlook. Cloudflare tied its growth to escalating digital threats, a good sign for security spending.

news.title: Will CRWD's Acquisitions of Fiddler and Dreadnode Boost its AI Growth?
news.summary: CrowdStrike's planned acquisitions of Fiddler AI and Dreadnode aim to strengthen Falcon's AI security capabilities and expand enterprise growth opportunities.

news.title: ‘You Should Just Go Buy CrowdStrike,’ Says Jim Cramer. But His Own Club Rates CRWD Stock a ‘Hold.’
news.summary: Cramer says viewers "should just go buy" CrowdStrike, but is it worth it at current valuation multiples?

news.title: What Are Wall Street Analysts' Target Price for CrowdStrike Stock?
news.summary: CrowdStrike has notably outperformed the broader market over the past year, and analysts are moderately optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

news.title: CrowdStrike Is Buying 2 AI Security Startups for Roughly $500 Million. What This Means for CRWD Stock.
news.summary: CrowdStrike is expanding into AI agent security with two acquisitions worth $495 million, but its premium valuation leaves investors questioning how much growth is already priced into CRWD stock.

news.title: CrowdStrike Sinks 9%, Palo Alto Down 8%, Cloudflare Down 9% as AI Trade Unwinds
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCrowdStrike shares fell 10% as investors sold off AI stocks, and the company had no news to explain the drop. Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler and Cloudflare fell with it, as the market sold cybersecurity as a group.

news.title: Palantir Tumbles 10%, CrowdStrike Sinks 9% as Wall Street Dumps Software’s AI Winners; Okta Drops 10%
news.summary: Software's biggest AI winners are getting hit hardest while the year's laggards barely move. A post-midterm shift in sentiment is reshaping who gets punished, and one security name is slipping far less than its peers.

news.title: Palantir and CrowdStrike stocks tumble as Wall Street dumps software's AI winners
news.summary: Investors are selling the software stocks that rode the AI boom and mostly sparing the ones that have been left behind.

news.title: Dan Ives Maintains Bullish Rating on CrowdStrike Stock Amid Tech Sector Selloff
news.summary: Dan Ives stays bullish on CrowdStrike stock as tech sinks. See why he would buy the dip and what CrowdStrike's new AI kill switch means for investors now.

news.title: CRWD Stock Plunges 13% in a Month: Should You Hold or Book Profits?
news.summary: CrowdStrike shares plunge 13.4% in a month. Slowing revenue growth, premium valuation and rising competition raise concerns about CRWD's outlook.

excerpts.text: Shopify Sustains Rapid Growth with Revenue Up 32% and Free Cash Flow Margin of 22% November 3, 2026 - Shopify announced today financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Shopify achieved 32% revenue growth (32% in constant currency) and a 22% free cash flow margin.

“Shopify is uncommonly good at operating in two realities at the same time: the world our merchants exist in today, and the one they are moving towards. Q3 is the perfect example. We powered $119 billion in GMV, while continuing to build commerce into every surface, every agent, and increasingly, everywhere,” said Harley Finkelstein, President of Shopify.

“We extended our track record of consistent execution, with 32% revenue growth and a 22% free cash flow margin,” said Jeff Hoffmeister, Chief Financial Officer of Shopify. “Delivering these results at our scale speaks to the strength of our model, our multiple growth drivers, and our expanding addressable market.”

The rules saw only a small risk drag, while headlines report a new round of job cuts with higher severance costs. They also report that the stock had its worst day ever after the company's outlook for a key growth measure in the coming quarter disappointed, although the rules found no clear new guidance in this week's news.
